Count the units out at the same time

Plan one type of interchangeable equipment at a time. Enter the stock available for hire, then paste each reservation’s pickup time, return time and quantity in the same local time zone. Peak demand is the largest number of units out together. Subtract your stock from that peak to find the shortfall.

Manage equipment rentals on Shopify →

Worked example

You have eight kayaks. Six go out from 10:00 to 13:00 and four more are booked from 12:00 to 15:00. You are two kayaks short from 12:00 until 13:00. Moving the second pickup to 13:00 clears the overlap if the first six are ready for immediate reuse.

Common questions

How does the planner handle a pickup at the previous return time?

A unit becomes available at the end time you enter. If a kayak needs 30 minutes for inspection after a noon return, enter 12:30 as the end of that reservation.

Can I plan bikes and helmets together?

Run a separate check for each stock pool. A reservation for three bikes and three helmets uses three units in each pool. Deduct damaged or unavailable items from the stock figure for that run.
